final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and largely narrowed the claim by reinterpreting the same record. That narrowing is useful, but it does not cure the policy gap. The policy allows certification only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. On the available record, those predicates are still unproven: the summary itself concedes no shown disclosure text, no approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance, and no resolved materiality assessment for the Spanish-language billing regression. Aggregate readiness, absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents, and public guidance on documenting limitations support a narrower argument that the packet is arguable in some respects, but they do not convert the unresolved certification predicate into compliance. Because the caveat here is not a minor bounded qualification but the missing condition the policy requires, `compliant_with_caveats` would overstate what the evidence supports.
remaining_concerns: The record still does not show current release documentation expressly reflecting the Spanish-language billing regression and current evaluation results.
The record still does not include approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance tied to the current release and that segment weakness.
Materiality of the Spanish-language billing regression remains unresolved in the admissible record.
Prior approval of the model family and informal monitoring comments remain contextual only under the policy and cannot satisfy the missing current-release predicate.
